shared_elements: rows of repeated short parallel strokes or bars
justification: The only correspondence is the generic presence of schematic linear motifs with repeated parallel strokes, something any tradition could produce independently. A shows sparse abstract comb-like/rectilinear signs with no figure at all, while B shows an elaborately costumed standing human figure with headdress, held objects and blocks of dense sign panels — entirely different subject matter and depictive conventions.
